_comment: Words for the local site: the chrome tools/serve-site.py wraps every page in, its home page, and the event index tools/build-card-index.py builds. Tag labels are NOT here -- they are read from sector-vocab.json's `tags`, so a tag reads the same on a sector page and in the event index.

nav.source_title: The generated file this page is served from

home.title: FTL Event Wiki
home.heading: FTL Event Wiki
home.lede: Every sector the map can offer and every event a beacon can hold, generated from the game's own files. Two ways in.
home.sectors_blurb: All 19 sectors under the designation the game's draw lists give them. Pin two side by side — the map offers two — and open either profile for its whole beacon budget.
home.cards_blurb: One decision tree per event: every choice, every outcome, every blue option, with the odds the files state and nothing where they state none.
home.note: Nothing on these pages is written by hand. Every number and every quoted line is read out of raw/gamedata.

seen.row_title: seen {n}× across {events} of the {total} events this line can place
seen.overlap_title: {n}× of that is counted on another line too: {list}

cards_index.title: FTL events
cards_index.heading: Event Cards
cards_index.lede: Every event with a card, searchable by name, by in-game id, by tag, and by the sector whose pool can place it.
cards_index.search: Search a name, an id, a tag…
cards_index.no_pool_hint: Reachable another way — a chain step, a fight outcome, the boss, or content the pool lists never name.
cards_index.note: A sector column counts the pools that can place the event, not how often it turns up. No file states that.
